Sydney Local Health District is seeking highly motivated Advanced Trainees to join the premier SLHD Geriatric Medicine Advanced Training Network

What you will be doing:
This position is open to qualified Advanced trainees in Geriatrics to practice under the supervision and direction of Specialist Geriatricians to assess and medically manage a comprehensive range of illnesses and disorders related to aged care.
 
The SLHD Geriatric Medicine Advanced Training Network offers you a comprehensive and well established Geriatric Medicine Advanced Training Program, with experienced supervisors, a wide range of formal education programs, a track record and resources for the completion of substantive projects. 

Our reputation is second to none with clinical rotations allocated according to your experience, interest and training needs. The final allocation would also take into account the service needs across the SLHD Geriatric Medicine network training sites.
There is opportunity for you to rotate through subspecialty training modules including orthogeriatrics, cognitive disorder clinics, surgical liaison service, psychogeriatrics, as well as a variety of community based Geriatric service initiatives.

The duration of the position is for one full year (twelve months), though many trainees would reapply in subsequent clinical years to continue their advanced training in the network to take full advantage of the training opportunities.

The SLHD Geriatric Medicine Training Network
All network rotation sites are part of the Sydney Local Health District. Sites for our Network rotations include: Concord Repatriation General Hospital, The Canterbury Hospital, Royal Prince Alfred Hospital and the Balmain Aged Care Departments. All positions will participate in rotations allocated across the training network. Each rotation is approximately of 3 months duration. 

The SLHD Geriatric Medicine Training Network encompasses the Aged Care departments and facilities of the Sydney Local Health District, covering the Sydney and Inner West Local Government Areas of Ashfield, Burwood, Canterbury, Canada Bay, Leichhardt, Marrickville, Strathfield, and part of the City of Sydney. 
This training network is accredited for three years of Geriatric Medicine Advanced Training by the RACP Geriatric Specialist Training Committee in recognition of the training opportunities available.

Where you will be working:

You will be based at one of the SLHD hospitals for each rotation. SLHD hospitals include Concord Repatriation General Hospital, The Canterbury Hospital and Royal Prince Alfred Hospital. All positions will participate in rotations allocated across the training network. If allocated to a community term you will experience outpatient care, community home visits, Residential Aged Care Outreach.

What we can offer you:
- Supportive, collegiate and diverse work environment
- Ongoing professional development and career opportunities
- Salary packaging and fitness passport for eligible staff
- Wellbeing, advocacy, mentorship and support opportunities exclusively for medical staff through SLHDs multifaceted workplace program MDOK.

SLHD is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and people with disability are encouraged to apply for all internal and externally advertised positions. If you require assistance, please advise the contact person at the time of your application.
 
Stepping Up aims to assist Aboriginal job applicants by providing information about applying for roles within NSW Health. For more information, please visit: http:--www.steppingup.health.nsw.gov.au-

Sydney Local Health District's vision incorporates NSW Health Core Values and a commitment to equity, health improvement, timeliness and efficiency, recognising that evidence-based service delivery requires highly skilled and valued staff supported by research, education and state-of-the-art technologies. 

Our strategic priority under this vision is our commitment to excellence in Patient and Family Centre Care. Staff are supported to ensure patients, their families and carers are considered as partners in care to achieve optimal patient outcomes and best possible healthcare experience.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Qualifications and experience commensurate with the Essential Requirements for the role.

Demonstrated commitment to training in Geriatric Medicine and previous experience in Aged Care Medicine.

Demonstrated ability to work independently within a supervised clinical environment using excellent clinical skills, judgement and expertise.

Good time management and organisational skills, and advanced computing skills.

Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) and demonstrated ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

Evidence of continued professional development and commitment to self-education as well as a willingness to teach and support junior medical staff.

Demonstrated commitment to quality improvement, patient safety and risk management.

Demonstrated interest and commitment to further education and practice in Geriatrics.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We've been caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care.It'sHammondCare.

About The Role

At HammondCare, technology plays a critical role in improving quality of life for people with complex health and aged care needs.We'reseekingan experienced and strategic technology leader to join our executive team asGeneral Manager - DigitalProducts&Platforms.

This is a significant leadership role,reporting to the CIO, you will ownHammondCare'sdigitalplatforms &productscapability, leading the teams responsible for building, evolving, and optimising the platforms that underpin care delivery, workforce productivity, business operations, and future innovation.

You'llhelp shape a modern product and platform operating model, bringing together product management, engineering, agile delivery, platform operations, architecture alignment, vendor management, and value realisation into a single, high-performing capability.

This is an opportunity to lead digital transformation at scale while ensuring our core platformsremainreliable, secure, integrated, and ready to support emerging AI and automation opportunities.

This is apermanentroleworking at St Leonards with hybrid opportunities.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap forHammondCare'sdigital products, platforms, and enterprise systems, ensuring alignment to organisational priorities and future growth

Lead multiple agile squads across Salesforce, ERP, care systems, integration services, and digital experience platforms, creating a high-performing delivery culture focused on outcomes

Establish and evolve a modern productand platform operating model that aligns product management, engineering, delivery, support, and business teams around customer value

Drive engineering excellence through Agile, DevOps, automation, quality engineering, secure-by-design principles, and modern delivery practices

Lead product adoption, platform utilisation, and benefits realisation, ensuring technology investments deliver measurable business and operational outcomes

Partner with Data, AI & Analytics leaders toestablishAI-ready platforms, ensuring the foundations for analytics, automation, and responsible AI adoption are in place

Lead strategic vendor, partner, and software supplier relationships, ensuring strong commercial outcomes, innovation, and value for money

About you

15+ years' experience leading enterprise technology products, platforms, digital services, or engineering organisations 

Demonstrated success leading large multidisciplinary teams across product, platform, engineering, delivery, and operational functions 

Experienceestablishingand scaling modern product and platform operating models 

Strong experience across enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, digital workplace, and care or customer-facing systems

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including:

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free) 

Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave 

Flexible working options 

Discounts on everyday products and services 

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families 

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families 

Health & Wellbeing programmes 

Reward & Recognition programmes 

Referral bonuses 

Career and professional development opportunities 

Our Culture

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive to create an equal employment environment for all.
